title: AI Engineering Orchestra Assignment
description: Structural schema for the AI Engineering Orchestra v0.1 Assignment contract defined by core/assignment-specification.md.

task_id.description: ID of the one Task to which this responsibility binding applies.

workflow_id.description: ID of the Workflow explicitly governing the Task.

stage_id.description: Workflow-scoped Stage ID containing the required responsibility.

role_id.description: Canonical Role ID required by the selected Stage.

actor_id.description: ID of the concrete Actor selected for the responsibility.
